verdict.rationale: Linear's own developer docs and repo describe importing data from other services, and the integration directory lists a Jira-to-Linear transition path, so the core migration story is directly supported. The evidence consists only of one-line mentions with no detail on what is imported or how. Missing for 10: which source tools are supported beyond Jira, what data is carried over (issues, comments, attachments, statuses), a step-by-step import workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of the importer.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over
